name: Mechanical Relations
source: Girlfriends Fritter and Marmalade find themselves stranded on a landfill moon in the middle of space! Marmalade seems to think of it as an impromptu vacation, while Fritter is a bit more hesitant to blow off steam. Maybe some alone time is just what they need?
translation: 女朋友Fritter和Marmalade发现自己被困在太空中央的一个垃圾填埋卫星上！Marmalade似乎认为这是一次即兴的假期，而Fritter则不太愿意发泄情绪。也许一些独处的时间正是他们所需要的？
